sourceRefs.locator: Abstract: Skhul II, V and IX; conditional 100–135 ka range and possible differences between burials
Description: the four caves, including Skhul, on the western slopes of Mount Carmel

summary.de: Höhle im Karmelgebirge mit frühen menschlichen Skelettfunden. Sie gehört zur Höhlengruppe Nahal Me’arot / Wadi el-Mughara. Das Foto zeigt den heutigen Eingang.
summary.en: A Mount Carmel cave with early human skeletal remains, within the Nahal Me’arot / Wadi el-Mughara cave group. The photograph shows its present-day entrance.
